attractions.name: Castelo de Serpa
attractions.rank: #1 of 35 things to do in Serpa
attractions.rating_snapshot: 4.2 / 137-140 reviews on 2025-2026 page versions; older tripadvisor.co.uk snapshot 4.0 / 135
attractions.description: Castelo de fundação medieval, reconstruído no reinado de D. Dinis e fortificado no século XVII, onde funciona o Museu Municipal de Arqueologia.
attractions.notes: Reviews say entry is free; some mention a broken lift and closures on Mondays.

attractions.name: Museu do Relogio
attractions.rank: #2 of 35 things to do in Serpa (another snapshot: #3)
attractions.address: Convento do Mosteirinho, Rua do Assento, Serpa (from non-TripAdvisor sources)
attractions.description: Museu de relojoaria aberto em 1995 no antigo Convento do Mosteirinho, com a coleção reunida por António Tavares d'Almeida e uma oficina de reparação.
attractions.notes: Collection size quoted inconsistently across sources (about 1,600 to 2,500 pieces); a reviewer quoted EUR 2 entry. Has a sister branch in Évora.

attractions.name: Aqueduto de Serpa
attractions.rank: #3 in the Top Attractions list (snippet)
attractions.description: Aqueduto do final do século XVII, construído sobre a muralha por iniciativa de D. Francisco de Melo para abastecer em exclusivo o Palácio dos Condes de Ficalho, com uma grande nora no extremo sul.

attractions.name: Muralhas de Serpa
attractions.rank: #4 of 35 things to do in Serpa
attractions.description: Cerca medieval de dupla muralha com torreões semicirculares, reerguida no reinado de D. Dinis, que conserva as Portas de Beja e de Moura e está classificada como Monumento Nacional.
attractions.notes: A municipal document cited in search results gives Monumento Nacional status since 1954 (Decreto 39 521); not checked against the decree itself.

attractions.name: Monte Das Louzeiras
attractions.type: Adega e lagar / provas (Wineries & Vineyards, Food & Drink)
attractions.rank: #6 of 35 things to do in Serpa (one snapshot; #4 in a Top Attractions list)
attractions.description: Produtor de azeite e vinho em Vale de Vargo com provas (incluindo vinho de ânfora), venda de produtos derivados do azeite e lugares para autocaravanas no olival.
attractions.notes: Located in the village of Vale de Vargo (concelho de Serpa), not in Serpa town. Listing shows hours approx. 9:00-18:00 weekdays, 10:00-17:00 Sundays.

attractions.name: Núcleo Intramuros da Vila de Serpa
attractions.rank: #6 of 35 things to do in Serpa (ranked 6th-9th across snapshots)
attractions.description: Zona histórica da vila delimitada pelas muralhas medievais, com ruas estreitas, a Praça da República, a Igreja de Santa Maria e a Torre do Relógio.

attractions.name: Ermida de Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe
attractions.rank: #7 of 35 things to do in Serpa (another snapshot: #8)
attractions.rating_snapshot: 4.3 / 16 reviews (6 excellent, 9 good, 1 average); a reviewer found it closed in Aug 2024
attractions.description: Santuário de peregrinação do início do século XVI no Alto de São Gens, com sacristia e casa do ermitão, dedicado a Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe, a quem o concelho foi consagrado em 1946.
attractions.notes: Different building from 'Igreja de Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe (Igreja de São Salvador)' in town. SIPA record name: Ermida de Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe / Ermida de São Gens / Santuário de Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe.

attractions.name: Torre do Relógio
attractions.type: Torre do relógio (Points of Interest & Landmarks)
attractions.rank: #8 of 35 things to do in Serpa
attractions.address: Largo dos Santos Proculo E Hilariao, Serpa 7830-385
attractions.description: Torre da antiga muralha do burgo medieval adaptada a torre de relógio em 1440, situada no Largo dos Santos Próculo e Hilarião, junto à entrada do castelo.
attractions.notes: Travel sources call it the third-oldest clock tower in Portugal; the current clock mechanism is reported as dating from 1841.

attractions.name: Igreja de Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe (Igreja de São Salvador)
attractions.rank: #9 of 35 things to do in Serpa (Jul 2024; another snapshot #10)
attractions.description: Igreja no Largo do Salvador cujo interior tem altar-mor, capelas laterais e painéis de azulejo, aberta sobretudo durante as celebrações religiosas, segundo comentários no Tripadvisor.
attractions.notes: No non-TripAdvisor source on this church was found before the search budget ran out. One review on this page seems to describe the hilltop Ermida instead.

attractions.name: Igreja e Convento de São Paulo / Mosteiro de Nossa Senhora da Consolação
attractions.rank: #10 in the top things to do list (snippet)
attractions.description: Igreja e convento de frades paulistas da Serra de Ossa, iniciados no final do século XVII, com exterior caiado e interior barroco; o conjunto é também designado Hospital de São Paulo.
attractions.notes: Reviewers note it was closed and that part of the building houses a health facility.

attractions.name: Museu Etnográfico de Serpa
attractions.rank: #11 of 35 things to do in Serpa (another list: #12)
attractions.description: Museu no Largo do Corro com coleções sobre ofícios artesanais e trabalho agrícola tradicional, incluindo o processo de fabrico do queijo.

attractions.notes: One TripAdvisor reviewer suggested the listing was confused with Beja's Igreja de Santa Maria; the address on the listing is in Serpa. Castle entrance is right behind it.

attractions.name: Palácio dos Condes de Ficalho

attractions.description: Palácio adossado às muralhas de Serpa, iniciado no final do século XVI e remodelado no século XVII, abastecido de água pelo aqueduto e classificado como Monumento Nacional em 2007.
attractions.notes: Misfiled: TripAdvisor lists it under Vila Verde de Ficalho, but the palace is in Serpa town (attached to the walls, supplied by the aqueduct). A TripAdvisor reviewer reported the Vila Verde de Ficalho council said the listing was wrong. Also called Palácio dos Melos / Solar dos Marqueses de Ficalho. Dating differs: the 2007 decree says begun late 16th c. and remodelled in the 17th c.; a 2024 study says it grew from a 15th-century building.

notes: Compiled 2026-10-13 from WebSearch result snippets only: direct access to tripadvisor.* (and WebFetch generally) failed with DNS errors, so ratings/ranks/counts come from search-engine snippets of TripAdvisor pages captured at different dates (page titles dated 2023-2026). Expect inconsistencies; where versions disagree the most recent-looking figure is in rating/review_count and the alternatives are in rating_snapshot. The WebSearch budget (200 calls per turn) ran out before every item could be cross-checked; items whose descriptions rely only on TripAdvisor text say so. TOTALS: TripAdvisor's Serpa geo (g189109) shows '35 things to do' (one snapshot '37 attractions') and, on the Oct-2026 restaurant page, '1,658 reviews of 35 Serpa restaurants' (older snapshots: 33, 32, 29, 23, 21, 19, 17). RANKS for attractions come from different snapshots and therefore collide (e.g. two items at #6, #17, #31). SEPARATE GEOS: TripAdvisor has its own geos for Pias (g652076), Vila Verde de Ficalho (g3226139) and Aldeia Nova de Sao Bento (= Vila Nova de São Bento, g4545644); their items are included and tagged in ta_geo. No geo or listings were found for Brinches, Vale de Vargo, A-do-Pinto or Santa Iria (except items filed under Serpa). MISFILED / LOCATED ELSEWHERE: Palácio dos Condes de Ficalho is filed under Vila Verde de Ficalho although the palace is in Serpa town; Pulo do Lobo is filed under Mértola (g1068892); Ermida de Santa Luzia (Serpa geo) is 2 km from Pias on the Pias-Moura road; Burrico D`Orada's address is on the EN258 Vidigueira-Moura road; Museu de Vila Nova de S. Bento, Igreja de São Bento, Igreja Paroquial de Aldeia Nova de São Bento and probably TAPAS.COMe are in Vila Nova de São Bento; Museu de Vila Verde de Ficalho is in Vila Verde de Ficalho; Monte Das Louzeiras is in Vale de Vargo; Igreja Paroquial de Santa Iria is in Santa Iria; Café Restaurante Agostinho is in Vale do Poço; Sociedade recriativa de vales mortos is in Vales Mortos; Clube De Tiro Dona Brites is on the EN 255; Ponte sobre a ribeira do Enxoé is between Serpa and Pias.
